# Ship or Skip

> Ship or Skip is a weekly newsletter and public scoreboard that hands-on tests new AI agent and vibe-coding tools and gives each a verdict: Ship, Skip, or Wait.

Each tool is run on a real task and scored out of 10 on: does it work, time-to-value, price, and hype vs reality. Every review includes receipts (the task run, a screenshot, and the failure mode). Each issue includes a "Skip this" pick. Sponsored tools are always disclosed and never scored favourably.

Status: launched October 2026. Issue #1 published 14 October 2026 (agent-engineer: Ship, Garuda: Ship*, Codync: Wait, Ruflo: Skip).

## Pages

- [Issue #1](https://shiporskip-ship-or-skip.vercel.app/issues/1): agent-engineer, Garuda, Codync and Ruflo tested hands-on with a local model
- [Scoreboard](https://shiporskip-ship-or-skip.vercel.app/scoreboard): every tool tested with scores and verdicts
- [About & methodology](https://shiporskip-ship-or-skip.vercel.app/about): how we test, scoring rubric, sponsor policy, corrections
- [Sponsor](https://shiporskip-ship-or-skip.vercel.app/sponsor): sponsorship terms and contact
- [Submit your tool: free review queue or $99 priority review (verdict never for sale)](https://shiporskip-ship-or-skip.vercel.app/submit): Submit your tool: free review queue or $99 priority review (verdict never for sale)
- [Which AI coding agent fits you? 4-question quiz](https://shiporskip-ship-or-skip.vercel.app/quiz): Which AI coding agent fits you? 4-question quiz
- [Index of sourced comparisons and alternatives](https://shiporskip-ship-or-skip.vercel.app/guides): Index of sourced comparisons and alternatives
